channel.title: Kanadevia Inova - news
channel.description: Feed gemaakt door feedtest voor Kanadevia Inova - news

item.title: Replacement of a combustion line at the Darmstadt Waste to Energy plant successfully completed
item.description: Kanadevia Inova Steinmüller has successfully completed the construction and commissioning of a new incineration line at the Waste to Energy plant in Darmstadt.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova to strengthen engineering and sourcing capabilities through acquisition of Indian engineering company
item.description: Acquisition supports more affordable and accessible circular city infrastructure while strengthening long-term competitiveness and growth.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova signs contract with SIG for the renewal of the Cheneviers Waste to Energy plant near Geneva
item.description: Kanadevia Inova has signed a contract with Services Industriels de Genève (SIG) for the renewal of the Waste to Energy facility at the Cheneviers site in Aire-la-Ville near Geneva.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova acquires majority stake in Dutch biogas platform BioValue
item.description: Swiss-based greentech leader strengthens its Northern European biogas platform with the strategic acquisition of BioValue, a leading Dutch biomethane developer, operator and service provider.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova and partners sign landmark concession & energy off-take agreements for integrated Waste to Energy project in Casablanca
item.description: anadevia Inova, together with its partners Nareva and Itochu, has reached a major milestone with the signing of the concession agreement for the Casablanca Solid Waste Treatment and Valorization Project with the Municipality of Casablanca, and with the signing of electricity off-take agreements with SRM Casablanca-Settat and ONEE.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova to advance the circular-city agenda at COP31
item.description: Swiss-based greentech leader will bring international experience in Waste-to-X, resource recovery and decarbonisation to the climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye.

item.title: Kanadevia Inova awarded contract for Wet AD plant in Sicily
item.description: Kanadevia Inova has been awarded a contract by Sicily Biomethan S.r.l. in connection with the development of a new Wet AD biogas plant with biomethane production in Castelvetrano, Sicily, Italy.
